tools.name: flood_info
tools.description: Report the version, scope and coverage of the public Flood catalog.

tools.name: search_flood
tools.description: Find public Flood components, ready-to-use compositions, tokens and agent guidance by name or by describing the UI task in English or Russian. Pass a result ID to read_flood for the full contract.

tools.name: read_flood
tools.description: Read one public material by ID. Omit length for up to 10,000 characters. Continue with nextOffset when present. Required prerequisites are listed separately from related materials.
